answer: A workable defense is a stake-and-slash bond tied to non-transferable reputation. Each agent locks a deposit before trading, and peers attest its work; a verified cheat forfeits the deposit, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Like an opal graded on a terrace of tests, reputation accrues only through sustained honest work and cannot be bought or moved, while ivory-tower shortcuts fail because fake accounts start with zero history and pay full price for every attempt.
